annotations.title: Deterministic NL-to-SQL Synthesizer & Dialect Query Generator

description: Translates natural language questions into dialect-accurate, optimized SQL SELECT queries with schema awareness and safety checks. Use when generating reporting queries or automated data analytics pipelines; for analyzing SQL execution performance and EXPLAIN plans, use analyze_query_plan instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'natural_language_request' and 'schema_ddl' ('sql_dialect' defaults to 'postgresql_dialect'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

natural_language_request.description: Natural language question or reporting requirement to transform into SQL.

read_only_mode.description: Whether to enforce strict read-only SELECT query constraints.

schema_ddl.description: Database schema DDL statements defining available tables, columns, and relations.

sql_dialect.description: Target SQL dialect specification: PostgreSQL dialect, MySQL dialect, or SQLite dialect.

name: synthesize_sql_query

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for synthesize_sql_query.

dialect.description: Database engine dialect target the query was generated for.

explanation.description: Step-by-step rationale explaining table joins, filtering predicates, and grouping logic.

safety_checked.description: True if AST static analysis verified the query has zero mutation side-effects.

sql_query.description: Synthesized, formatted SQL query tailored to the provided schema and dialect.

title: Deterministic NL-to-SQL Synthesizer & Dialect Query Generator
